DLA Weapons Support (Warren) currently has a PRE-SOLICITATION posted for:

Item: Transmission Shipping and Storage Container | NSN: 8145-00-695-9008 | Part Number: 8723296

*****This procurement is set aside for Small Business*****

Quantity: 8 each with 100% option                                                                  

FOB: Destination

The solicitation number is SPRDL1-26-Q-0033.

Technical Data is available for this procurement. All responsible sources may submit a capability statement, proposal or quotation, which will be considered by the agency. No hard copies of the solicitation will be issued; you must download it from Sam.gov.

 If you have any questions, please contact the Contract Specialist, Sabrina Swain, at (586) 854-0070, or email address: sabrina.swain@dla.mil.
